title: Books of the Bible (73-book Catholic canon)
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Knowing the books in order makes it quick to find a passage, and it shows how the Bible is laid out: the Pentateuch, the historical books, the wisdom books and the prophets, then the Gospels and letters.

How to hold it: Seventy-three names is a long list, so chunk it by section: the Pentateuch, the historical books, the wisdom books, the prophets, then the New Testament. Long sections are split into groups of about five. Sing each section to a tune you know; the rhythm carries the order, and the sections give you a map when a name slips.
This list has 73 items. Answer below, then check — the practice button generates fresh questions from the list itself.
